name: Asha
description: Principal-Agent Fiduciary Medical Intelligence. Evidence-grounded clinical answers from 121M+ vectors across ~591 knowledge collections including PubMed, StatPearls, FDA drug labels, ICD-10, and clinical guidelines.

skills.name: Medical Question Answering
skills.description: Evidence-based medical Q&A grounded in PubMed, StatPearls, FDA drug labels, and clinical guidelines. 121M vectors of medical knowledge.
examples: What are the latest treatment guidelines for type 2 diabetes?
Compare SSRIs vs SNRIs for treatment-resistant depression
What is the mechanism of action of semaglutide?

skills.name: Drug Interaction Check
skills.description: Check for clinically significant drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and pharmacokinetic conflicts using DailyMed and FDA label data.
examples: Are there interactions between metformin and lisinopril?
Can a patient on warfarin safely take ibuprofen?
Check interactions for sertraline, trazodone, and bupropion together

skills.name: Clinical Guideline Lookup
skills.description: Retrieve and summarize current clinical practice guidelines from AHA, ADA, USPSTF, WHO, and specialty societies.
examples: What are the AHA 2025 hypertension management guidelines?
USPSTF screening recommendations for colorectal cancer

skills.name: Evidence Synthesis
skills.description: Synthesize evidence across multiple sources — PubMed abstracts, OpenAlex citations, PMC full-text, and StatPearls — into a coherent clinical summary with citation support.
examples: Summarize the evidence for ketamine in treatment-resistant depression
What does the literature say about GLP-1 agonists and cardiovascular outcomes?
Synthesize evidence on psilocybin for end-of-life anxiety
